source_reading.reading: complete, pages 1–52, Sections 1–7, Appendix A, all displayed arguments and references
proofs_checked: genie-aided outer bounds for weak/mixed interference
Han–Kobayashi inner region specialization and one-bit gap
strong/very-strong regimes and generalized degrees-of-freedom calculations
limitations: The one-bit region theorem is for the two-user Gaussian IC and gives an approximate region; it is not exact capacity in weak/mixed regimes.

source_reading.reading: complete, pages 1–55, Sections 1–8, Appendices A–H, all displayed arguments and references
proofs_checked: distributed Gaussian test-channel achievability and worst-case property
M-sums extensions and symmetric many-source sum-rate result
limitations: Exact region applies to the paper’s two scalar Gaussian sources, separate MSE constraints and specified model; the paper gives only restricted extensions beyond that.

source_reading.reading: complete, pages 1–33, Sections I–VI, Appendices A–C, all displayed arguments and references
proofs_checked: multicast NNC random codebook, message repetition, relay compression, simultaneous nonunique decoding and error exponents
limitations: NNC and cutset are inner/outer bounds for general noisy networks. The article proves exactness only for specified special cases and does not establish general network capacity.

source_reading.reading: complete read, lines 1-2407, all 21 pages, Sections I-VI, Appendices A-G, references, and biographies; source-identifying text was read in page order, not inferred from extraction alone
visual_cross_checks: Printed page 3136: final Theorem 4 states the uniform (R_1-0.63N,...,R_N-0.63N) shift.
Printed pages 3141-3142: Section V-A equations (19)-(20), Gaussian quantizer, matrix-lemma bound, and explicit common signed-vector construction.
Printed pages 3146-3147: Appendix D proof of Lemma 1, including the water-filling reduction and Lemma 3.
Compared against arXiv:1002.3188v2 Theorem 4: the final journal version changes the theorem statement and proof; it does not repeat the preprint's sharp cut-dependent vector wording.
proofs_checked: Final Gaussian multicast cut-set outer relaxation and unit-variance/gamma-variance NNC test-channel calculations
New PSD-matrix Lemma 1 and Appendix D proof
Common signed rate shift and minimization yielding the 0.63N bound
Positive-part repair derived locally from the active-message NNC error-event decomposition; auditor independently verified the cut restriction
limitations: The final journal statement omits clipping negative shifted coordinates to zero; the local note supplies and proves the operational positive-part repair.
The final version gives a global per-coordinate 0.63N gap, not the sharper cut-dependent vector statement made in arXiv v2.
